name: normal
description: Walks and eats the first plant it reaches

name: conehead
description: Normal zombie protected by a traffic cone

name: buckethead
description: Normal zombie protected by a metal bucket

name: blockhead
description: Zombie with a stone block on its head

name: knight
description: Armored knight; magnet-shroom can steal its helmet

name: gargantuar
description: Slow giant; kills a plant in one hit and throws its imp at half health

name: imp
description: Small and fast; damages plants quicker

name: ra
description: Pulls suns lying on the ground toward himself; returns them all when killed

name: explorer
description: His torch burns any plant less than a tile ahead; icy shots put the torch out

name: tombraiser
description: Every few seconds throws bones that raise graves on two random tiles

name: dodo-rider
description: Flies over plants and obstacles; only tall defensive walls stop it

name: hunter
description: Throws ice at the closest plant in his row; three hits freeze it solid

name: troglobite
description: Pushes ice blocks that crush any plant standing in the way

name: fisherman
description: Wades in from the sea and reels your plants toward himself

name: octopus
description: Throws octopuses that pin down plants in his row until removed

name: snorkel
description: Dives underwater where only lobbed shots can reach him

name: jester
description: Spins and reflects straight projectiles back at your plants

name: wizard
description: Turns a plant into a harmless sheep every few seconds

name: king
description: Sits on his throne and knights nearby simple zombies

name: imp-dragon
description: A quick imp whose scales shrug off fiery shots

name: all-star
description: Charges fast; first plant hit is destroyed instantly then he slows down

name: arcade
description: Solid and steady; soaks up a great many peas before he drops

name: parasol
description: Her parasol deflects every lobbed projectile

name: turquoise
description: Costly to field for how little he can take; send him with company

name: prospector
description: The slowest walker on the lawn
column8: and among the cheapest to send

name: piano
description: Crawls along
column8: but chews through even a wall-nut in about a second

name: newspaper
description: Loses his newspaper when hit enough and then storms forward enraged

name: peashooter-zombie
description: Zombotany zombie with a peashooter head; shoots your plants from afar

name: wallnut-zombie
description: Zombotany zombie with a wall-nut head; very tough but slow

name: jalapeno-zombie
description: Zombotany zombie that burns its whole row if not killed within ten seconds

name: squash-zombie
description: Zombotany zombie that squashes the first plant it reaches and dies with it

name: sun-zombie
description: Stationary zombie of i-Zombie stages that produces sun for the zombie side
